title: SimBench-BW measurement manifest
description: Per-measurement sidecar written alongside every timing / trace artifact. Records the device-identity fields captured at orchestrator startup plus the run metadata (iteration counts, compiler flags). Every measurement record in suite_results.json must have exactly one of these. Schema v2 removed the `ncu` mode and the `lock_mode` field; the project's measurement contract is non-root cloud-only with no clock-lock primitive, so neither slot is meaningful anymore.

cv_pct.description: Coefficient of variation of timing samples, in percent.

gpu_sku.description: Short SKU label (e.g. rtx_pro_6000_blackwell, h100_sxm, rtx_3090_ti).

gpu_uuid.description: Device UUID from cuDeviceGetUuid or cudaDeviceProp.uuid.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel executable produced by nvcc.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel source / .cu file used as the operator-pinned source-of-truth for the kernel-signature join key. Optional: emitted by the local-label producer (activation_trace_orchestrator + run_suite trace path) so the sweep harness's `--measurement-manifests` contract has a single source of truth for the join-key field. Historical run_suite.py timing/correctness manifests omit this field and are still admitted.

register_cap.description: Optional register-cap build-variant axis (the -maxrregcount cap). Present only for a register_cap build-variant cell; absent for a base cell. Paired with variant_id (== register_cap_<register_cap>). Additive optional field staged by the variant-aware manifest staging path from the per-variant trace JSON; absence keeps base manifests byte-compatible. Mirrors the optional register_cap on local_label_admitted.schema.json / local_label_sidecar.schema.json.

variant_id.description: Optional canonical build-variant identity string (register_cap_<cap>, ASCII-decimal, no leading zeros) for a register_cap build-variant cell. Absent for a base cell. The canonical-decimal pattern mirrors local_label_admitted.schema.json so one physical cap cannot be staged under two aliases (register_cap_64 vs register_cap_064).

compiler_flags.description: Exact nvcc flag list used to produce the binary. Preserves -gencode and -Xptxas content.

kb_capability_card.description: Authoritative feature-surface reference for the Blackwell target. Required on every run.

shape_point.description: Name of the shape_point used for this measurement; references a named entry in shapes/<slug>.toml.

trace_volume_exceeded_sidecar.description: Relative path to the trace_volume_exceeded.json sidecar when mode=trace and the run hit the budget. Absent otherwise.

tolerance_triplet.description: Tolerance key applied when mode=correctness; looked up in tolerances.toml.

enable_cupti_activity.description: Historical provenance flag retained for replay of pre-S4 timing manifests. A true value records that the now-retired CUPTI Activity collector ran and that historical sibling sidecars may be validated; false or absent records no historical CUPTI capture. Active producers do not emit this field, invoke the collector, or create CUPTI sidecars.

nvml_polling_interval_ns.description: Historical NVML sampler target interval, in nanoseconds, retained only on pre-S4 manifests that enabled the retired CUPTI/NVML path. Replay requires each referenced historical NVML sidecar's polling_interval_ns to equal this cached value. Active producers do not emit this field; the 10000000 ns ceiling preserves the frozen 100 Hz floor.

nvml_claim_scope.description: Historical NVML covariate claim-scope label cached by the retired timing producer. Replay admits only the frozen `measured_local` value. Active producers do not emit this field or initiate NVML capture.

nvml_sidecar_paths.description: Relative filenames of retained pre-S4 per-repeat NVML covariate sidecars. Replay may walk these historical siblings, verify cached-field equality, and compare their status union with `nvml_collector_status`. Active producers do not emit this field or create NVML sidecars.

nvml_collector_status.description: Cached union of per-repeat NVML collector statuses retained on a pre-S4 timing manifest. The first four values mirror the frozen nvml_covariate.schema.json replay enum; `nvml_covariate_mixed` denotes a heterogeneous historical union. Replay rejects disagreement with the referenced sidecars. Active producers do not emit this field.
